立即运行此工作流程弗洛伊

它是如何运作的

第 1 步：写下提示描述您想要的图像。命名主题、灯光和设置。 Z-Image Turbo 擅长真实感和在图像内渲染短文本，因此请拼出您想要显示的任何单词。适用于：照片级真实场景、产品照片、带文字的图像

步骤 2. 开始奔跑模型和设置已拨入。对于第一次运行，无需更改任何内容，点击运行并等待几秒钟。

步骤 3. 下载您的图像您将得到一个 1024 x 1024 PNG。它可以直接放入任何设计或编辑工具中。适用于：Photoshop · Figma · Canva · 任何编辑器

第一次？将所有设置保留原样。默认值（1024 x 1024 · 9 步骤 · CFG 1 · 随机种子）对于几乎每个人来说都是正确的起点。

推荐设置

快速入门指南。找到与您的目标匹配的目标并复制设置。

  • 标准一代（大多数人）从这里开始：1024 x 1024 · 9 个步骤 · CFG 1 · 欧拉 · 随机种子。对几乎每个人来说都是正确的起点。

  • 希望图像中的文字清晰可见：在提示中明确说明确切的单词及其位置。 “一个用粗体红色字母写着‘OPEN’的标志”比“一个标志”读起来更好。

  • 重现您喜欢的结果：将种子锁定到产生它的号码。相同的种子和相同的提示再次为您提供相同的图像。

  • 想要一批变化：保持种子随机并提高批量大小。每次运行都会让您对同一提示有新的认识。

  • 肖像或风景取景：更改潜在的宽度和高度。纵向为 832 x 1216，横向为 1216 x 832。总像素保持在 1 兆像素附近，以获得最清晰的结果。

  • 结果看起来煮过头或不自然：将 CFG 保持在 1。Z-Image Turbo 是一个精炼的 Turbo 模型，经过调整可以在没有严格引导的情况下运行。将 CFG 推高往往会使边缘变硬并冲掉细节。

RUN THIS WORKFLOW NOW ONFLOYO

HOW IT WORKS

Step 1. Write your promptDescribe the image you want. Name the subject, the lighting, and the setting. Z-Image Turbo is strong at photorealism and at rendering short text inside the image, so spell out any words you want to appear.Works great with: photorealistic scenes · product shots · images with text

Step 2. Hit runThe model and settings are already dialled in. For a first run, change nothing, hit run and wait a few seconds.

Step 3. Download your imageYou get back a 1024 x 1024 PNG. It drops straight into any design or editing tool.Ready for: Photoshop · Figma · Canva · any editor

First time?Leave every setting as-is. The defaults (1024 x 1024 · 9 steps · CFG 1 · random seed) are the right starting point for almost everyone.

RECOMMENDED SETTINGS

Quick-start guide. Find the goal that matches yours and copy the settings.

  • Standard generation (most people) Start here: 1024 x 1024 · 9 steps · CFG 1 · euler · random seed. The right starting point for almost everyone.

  • Want text in the image to come out clean: Be explicit in the prompt about the exact words and where they sit. "A sign that reads 'OPEN' in bold red letters" reads better than "a sign."

  • Reproduce a result you liked: Lock the seed to the number that produced it. Same seed and same prompt gives you the same image again.

  • Want a batch of variations: Keep the seed on random and raise the batch size. Each run gives you a fresh take on the same prompt.

  • Portrait or landscape framing: Change the width and height on the latent. 832 x 1216 for portrait, 1216 x 832 for landscape. Stay near a 1-megapixel total for the cleanest result.

  • Result looks over-cooked or unnatural: Keep CFG at 1. Z-Image Turbo is a distilled turbo model and is tuned to run without heavy guidance. Pushing CFG higher tends to harden edges and wash out detail.
